#Block A. Core RW + helpers（Sholl BLUE only）

```{r}
# =========================
# Block A1: BLUE RW core
# =========================
rw_path_2d_multi_to_center <- function(prob2d, x_start, y_start, x0, y0,
                                       n_steps = 5000,
                                       alpha = 12.0,
                                       step_size = 5,
                                       n_cand = 200,
                                       radius = 200,
                                       eps = 1e-6) {
  H <- nrow(prob2d); W <- ncol(prob2d)
  r2 <- radius^2

  x <- integer(n_steps + 1); y <- integer(n_steps + 1)
  x[1] <- x_start; y[1] <- y_start

  for (t in 1:n_steps) {
    s <- as.integer(step_size)
    if (!is.finite(s) || is.na(s) || s < 1) s <- 1L

    dx <- sample.int(2*s + 1, n_cand, replace = TRUE) - (s + 1)
    dy <- sample.int(2*s + 1, n_cand, replace = TRUE) - (s + 1)
    keep0 <- !(dx == 0 & dy == 0)
    dx <- dx[keep0]; dy <- dy[keep0]

    xx <- x[t] + dx
    yy <- y[t] + dy

    keep <- (xx >= 1 & xx <= W & yy >= 1 & yy <= H)
    keep <- keep & ((xx - x0)^2 + (yy - y0)^2 <= r2)

    d_cur2 <- (x[t] - x0)^2 + (y[t] - y0)^2
    d_new2 <- (xx - x0)^2 + (yy - y0)^2
    keep <- keep & (d_new2 <= d_cur2 + 3)

    xx <- xx[keep]; yy <- yy[keep]
    if (length(xx) == 0) {
      x <- x[1:t]; y <- y[1:t]
      return(data.frame(step = 0:(t-1), x = x, y = y))
    }

    w <- (pmax(prob2d[cbind(yy, xx)], 0) + eps)^alpha
    if (!all(is.finite(w)) || sum(w) <= 0) w <- rep(1, length(w))
    p <- w / sum(w)

    k <- sample.int(length(xx), 1, prob = p)
    x[t + 1] <- xx[k]
    y[t + 1] <- yy[k]

    if ((x[t + 1] - x0)^2 + (y[t + 1] - y0)^2 <= 2^2) {
      x <- x[1:(t+1)]; y <- y[1:(t+1)]
      return(data.frame(step = 0:t, x = x, y = y))
    }
  }

  data.frame(step = 0:n_steps, x = x, y = y)
}

# =========================
# Block A2: boundary candidates
# =========================
get_boundary_points <- function(prob2d, x0, y0, radius = 200, n_theta = 1440) {
  H <- nrow(prob2d); W <- ncol(prob2d)
  theta <- seq(0, 2*pi, length.out = n_theta)
  xs <- round(x0 + radius * cos(theta))
  ys <- round(y0 + radius * sin(theta))
  keep <- (xs >= 1 & xs <= W & ys >= 1 & ys <= H)
  xs <- xs[keep]; ys <- ys[keep]
  vals <- prob2d[cbind(ys, xs)]
  vals[!is.finite(vals)] <- 0
  unique(data.frame(x = xs, y = ys, val = vals))
}

# =========================
# Block A3: run one BLUE round (radius) + optional drop + archive
# =========================
run_blue_round <- function(prob2d, x0, y0, radius,
                           n_theta_boundary,
                           K_boundary, min_sep_boundary,
                           n_steps_rw, alpha_rw, step_rw, n_cand_rw, eps_rw,
                           drop_ids = integer(0)) {

  H <- nrow(prob2d); W <- ncol(prob2d)

  boundary_df <- get_boundary_points(prob2d, x0, y0, radius = radius, n_theta = n_theta_boundary)
  boundary_df <- boundary_df[order(-boundary_df$val), ]

  # pick seeds with separation
  seeds <- data.frame(x=integer(0), y=integer(0), val=numeric(0))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(boundary_df))) {
    cand <- boundary_df[i, ]
    if (nrow(seeds) == 0) {
      seeds <- rbind(seeds, cand)
    } else {
      d2 <- (seeds$x - cand$x)^2 + (seeds$y - cand$y)^2
      if (all(d2 >= min_sep_boundary^2)) seeds <- rbind(seeds, cand)
    }
    if (nrow(seeds) >= K_boundary) break
  }
  seeds <- seeds[, c("x","y","val")]

  # trace
  paths_back <- vector("list", nrow(seeds))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(seeds))) {
    paths_back[[i]] <- rw_path_2d_multi_to_center(
      prob2d,
      x_start = seeds$x[i], y_start = seeds$y[i],
      x0 = x0, y0 = y0,
      n_steps = n_steps_rw,
      alpha = alpha_rw,
      step_size = step_rw,
      n_cand = n_cand_rw,
      radius = radius,
      eps = eps_rw
    )
  }

  # optional drop ids (seed/path index)
  if (length(drop_ids) > 0) {
    keep_idx <- setdiff(seq_along(paths_back), drop_ids)
    paths_back <- paths_back[keep_idx]
    seeds <- seeds[keep_idx, , drop = FALSE]
  }

  list(
    radius_lim = radius,
    x0=x0, y0=y0,
    H=H, W=W,
    seeds = seeds,
    paths_back = paths_back
  )
}

# =========================
# Block A4: plotting helpers
# =========================
plot_blue_only <- function(prob2d, blue_obj, main = NULL) {
  H <- blue_obj$H
  x0 <- blue_obj$x0; y0 <- blue_obj$y0
  r  <- blue_obj$radius_lim

  plotIM(t(prob2d)[, H:1])

  theta <- seq(0, 2*pi, length.out = 400)
  lines(x0 + r*cos(theta),
        (H - y0 + 1) + r*sin(theta),
        col = "cyan", lwd = 2)

  for (pth in blue_obj$paths_back) {
    if (is.null(pth) || nrow(pth) == 0) next
    lines(pth$x, H - pth$y + 1, col = "blue", lwd = 3)
  }

  points(x0, H - y0 + 1, pch = 4, col = "yellow", lwd = 2, cex = 1.8)
  points(blue_obj$seeds$x, H - blue_obj$seeds$y + 1, pch = 16, col = "red", cex = 1.1)

  if (!is.null(main)) title(main)
}

plot_overlay_all_rounds <- function(prob2d, blue_list, outer_circle = NULL, main = "Overlay all rounds") {
  H <- nrow(prob2d)
  plotIM(t(prob2d)[, H:1])

  if (is.null(outer_circle)) outer_circle <- max(sapply(blue_list, function(b) b$radius_lim))
  theta <- seq(0, 2*pi, length.out = 400)

  # outer circle
  lines(blue_list[[1]]$x0 + outer_circle*cos(theta),
        (H - blue_list[[1]]$y0 + 1) + outer_circle*sin(theta),
        col = "cyan", lwd = 2)

  # all paths in red
  for (b in blue_list) {
    for (pth in b$paths_back) {
      if (is.null(pth) || nrow(pth) == 0) next
      lines(pth$x, H - pth$y + 1, col = "red", lwd = 3)
    }
  }

  points(blue_list[[1]]$x0, H - blue_list[[1]]$y0 + 1,
         pch = 4, col = "yellow", lwd = 2, cex = 1.8)
  title(main)
}
```

#Block D. AUTO multi-round

```{r}
# =========================
# Block D: auto multi-round BLUE
# =========================

K_boundary <- 8 # set your own boundary 

auto_blue_rounds <- function(prob2d, x0, y0,
                             radius_max = 120,
                             shrink = 0.60,
                             n_round = 5,
                             n_theta_boundary,
                             K_boundary, min_sep_boundary,
                             n_steps_rw, alpha_rw, step_rw, n_cand_rw, eps_rw,
                             drop_ids_list = NULL) {

  radii <- round(radius_max * shrink^(0:(n_round-1)))
  radii[radii < 5] <- 5

  if (is.null(drop_ids_list)) {
    drop_ids_list <- replicate(n_round, integer(0), simplify = FALSE)
  }
  stopifnot(length(drop_ids_list) == n_round)

  blue_list <- vector("list", n_round)
  for (k in seq_len(n_round)) {
    rk <- radii[k]
    blue_list[[k]] <- run_blue_round(
      prob2d, x0, y0, radius = rk,
      n_theta_boundary = n_theta_boundary,
      K_boundary = K_boundary, min_sep_boundary = min_sep_boundary,
      n_steps_rw = n_steps_rw, alpha_rw = alpha_rw, step_rw = step_rw, n_cand_rw = n_cand_rw, eps_rw = eps_rw,
      drop_ids = drop_ids_list[[k]]
    )
    cat(sprintf("[Round %d] radius=%d  #paths=%d  non-empty=%d\n",
                k, rk,
                length(blue_list[[k]]$paths_back),
                sum(sapply(blue_list[[k]]$paths_back, function(p) !is.null(p) && nrow(p)>0))))
  }

  names(blue_list) <- paste0("blue_r", radii)
  attr(blue_list, "radii") <- radii
  blue_list
}

```



```{r}
K_boundary <- 6
blue_auto <- auto_blue_rounds(
  prob2d, x0, y0,
  radius_max = 100,
  shrink = 0.70,

  K_boundary = K_boundary,

  alpha_rw = alpha_rw,
  step_rw = step_rw,
  n_cand_rw = n_cand_rw,
  eps_rw = eps_rw
)

plot_overlay_all_rounds(prob2d, blue_auto, outer_circle = 100,
                        main = "AUTO multi-round BLUE overlay")
```

#Block E. Support filter

```{r}
# =========================
# Block E: support filter by angle
# =========================
angle_of_seed <- function(x, y, x0, y0) atan2(y - y0, x - x0)

circ_diff <- function(a, b) {
  d <- abs(a - b)
  pmin(d, 2*pi - d)
}

filter_round1_by_support <- function(blue_auto, support_rounds = c(2,3), angle_tol_deg = 25) {
  angle_tol <- angle_tol_deg * pi / 180

  b1 <- blue_auto[[1]]
  th1 <- angle_of_seed(b1$seeds$x, b1$seeds$y, b1$x0, b1$y0)

  support_thetas <- lapply(support_rounds, function(rr) {
    br <- blue_auto[[rr]]
    angle_of_seed(br$seeds$x, br$seeds$y, br$x0, br$y0)
  })

  keep <- rep(TRUE, length(th1))
  for (i in seq_along(th1)) {
    ok_all <- TRUE
    for (th_sup in support_thetas) {
      detected <- any(circ_diff(th_sup, th1[i]) <= angle_tol)
      if (!detected) { ok_all <- FALSE; break }
    }
    keep[i] <- ok_all
  }

  blue_auto[[1]]$seeds <- blue_auto[[1]]$seeds[keep, , drop=FALSE]
  blue_auto[[1]]$paths_back <- blue_auto[[1]]$paths_back[keep]

  cat("Round1: kept =", sum(keep), "/", length(keep), "\n")
  blue_auto
}

blue_auto_filt <- filter_round1_by_support(blue_auto, support_rounds = c(2,3), angle_tol_deg = 10)

plot_overlay_all_rounds(prob2d, blue_auto_filt, outer_circle = 100,
                        main = "Overlay after support filter (Round1 filtered)")
```
